description:
FILED s440 (Fable, at the USER's stop: "when we restart look at why CI failed").  Facts: the annotation (tools/ci-step) shows the whole gate green except glob-01.t row 29 of 41; that file's run_pcl loads the RUNTIME FROM SOURCE (`sbcl --noinform --non-interactive --load $runtime --load $cl_file`, no saved core -- 45 s for 41 rows locally), so under a loaded 4-core runner each row pays a ~1.2 s recompile and is exposed to timing; the row globs a per-process tempdir (3 .txt files) and greps for a.txt.  Hypotheses to test in order: (1) run_pcl captures stdout+stderr (`2>&1`) and the `like($output, qr/1/)` sees an SBCL note or a runtime warning line instead -- make the row assert the exact output; (2) a tempdir listing race is impossible (files are created before the row), so if (1) is not it, look at p-glob's directory read under load (%p-glob--expand-dir); (3) switch glob-01.t's run_pcl to PCLCore::sbcl_prefix (the cached core, like its siblings) -- faster AND removes the source-mode variable.  Bar: the row asserts exact output; the file under `prove -j8` three times locally green; CI green twice in a row.

PROGRESS s444 (Fable): hypotheses (1)+(3) SHIPPED on main (c76875a) â run_pcl now takes PCLCore::sbcl_prefix (the cached core; 45 s -> 5 s) and row 29 asserts is($output, "1") exactly, so a recurrence prints the actual output.  Local bar met: file green 4x.  REMAINS: CI green twice in a row after the next push; only if it recurs, hypothesis (2) (%p-glob--expand-dir under load).

RECURRED LOCALLY s446m (Opus, agent M, 2026-08-25) on the post-c76875a code: a tools/prove-core run under a HEAVILY LOADED machine (parallel agents; the gate took 300 s instead of ~265) failed Pl/t/glob-01.t rows 29 AND 30 with "Tests: 41 Failed: 2" and a non-zero exit -- and the file is green alone 3x and in an immediate re-run of the whole gate on the same tree.  So the flake is LOAD-dependent and not CI-specific, and it is not confined to row 29: row 30 (the [a-c] range) went with it, and the file produced ONE MORE row than its 40, which suggests the failing run\'s output was mis-aligned rather than merely wrong.  That points at hypothesis (2) (%p-glob--expand-dir under load) or at the run_pcl output capture, not at timing alone.  Next recurrence: capture the row\'s actual output -- it is asserted exactly now, so a verbose run prints it.

s445 (Fable): CI HALF MET -- four consecutive green runs (e9cc3a7, 0cede82, ad6553d, c74e11f, checked via the public API 2026-08-25). The task STAYS OPEN on s446m's local recurrence under load (rows 29 AND 30 failing with "Tests: 41" -- one row too many reported, which points at the output capture or %p-glob--expand-dir, not timing alone); that is the remaining half.
subject: CI FLAKE to explain: run 32659444457 (commit 23e3005, the baselines move -- no code change) failed ONLY Pl/t/glob-01.t row 29 (`grep { /\/a\.txt$/ } <$tmpdir/*.txt>` printed something without a 1) in a 662-s gate (normal ~340 s); the runs before and after passed and it passes locally -- find the environment/load dependence
